mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.email AS author_name FROM ticket_comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE c.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_comments (ticket_id, author_id, author_type, content, is_private, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{ticketId}, #{authorId}, #{authorType}, #{content}, #{isPrivate}, datetime('now'), datetime('now'))
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_comments SET content = #{content}, is_edited = 1, edited_at = datetime('now'), updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{id}
